headline: Every pack of smallgoods checked, not a sample.
label: #FFF8EC
visitLine: Call and visit to Dandenong South
heroLede: With several halal meats and cuts going through slicing and packing, checking every seal, label and code by eye takes a lot of your team's time. Here's what a camera check could look like on your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every vacuum pack is sealed flat across the end, with no creases and no film sitting loose. A leaker shortens shelf life and turns into a complaint once it is on the shelf.
labelLede: Sliced chicken and sliced beef can look much the same through the film. The camera checks every pack carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: Sliced smallgoods carry a use-by date that has to be right on every pack. The system reads the printed date and batch code on every pack and compares them with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Casings, clips, glove pieces and packaging offcuts are all close at hand in a smallgoods plant. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four creased seals in fifteen minutes on Line 1. Check the vacuum sealer.
